content:
Generate a 9-panel horizontal film-strip storyboard image first (with strict style consistency across panels), then use that image as the reference input for Seedance 2.0 to drive a sequential cinematic video.

When using a multi-panel storyboard image as reference, explicitly instruct Seedance to ignore the grid/film-strip layout and output only full-screen 16:9 shots (no collage/split-screen), using the reference for content and style only.

Specify an exact shot-by-shot timeline with timestamps (e.g., 9 shots over 15 seconds) and enforce strict order so Seedance follows the intended sequence.

Add hard negative constraints to prevent unwanted overlays: NO frames, borders, film strips, numbers, UI, or text anywhere; ZERO TEXT.

Reinforce visual consistency by repeating key style tokens in both image and video prompts (e.g., deep blue + gold palette, holographic interfaces, volumetric lighting, photorealistic space environments, cinematic 8k).

Include explicit camera direction per shot (push-in, extreme close-up, over-the-shoulder, rotate around subject, tracking shot, pull-back) to control motion and composition.
